questions.q: What is the author proud of at the start of the video?
o: A channel with 20,000 subscribers, a second gym and a soon-to-open café
questions.e: In the video: "osim YouTube kanala od 20.000 vas, napravio sam još jedan džim, i evo, samo što nisam napravio još jedan kafić" — besides a YouTube channel of 20,000 of you, I built another gym, and, look, I've almost built another café.

questions.q: What is the author preparing for the round numbers of subscribers?
o: A big giveaway with several prizes
questions.e: In the video: "spremam vam neki veći giveaway. Dakle, hoću da bude nekoliko nagrada" — I'm preparing a bigger giveaway for you. So I want there to be several prizes.

questions.q: Where is the Grind coffee café being built?
questions.e: In the video: "Sad sam se uputio na Vračar... idemo taman da vidimo gradilište... Grind coffee" — I've now headed to Vračar... let's go see the construction site... Grind coffee.

questions.q: By when do they want to finish renovating the café?
o: By the end of the year
questions.e: In the video: "Verujemo da ćemo do 15. maja sve završiti" — we believe we'll finish everything by May 15.

questions.q: What ratings did Tašmajdan Park get for workouts?
questions.e: In the video: "Dakle, Tašmajdanski park je možda i najbolje mesto za trening. Naše ocene su 7 i 8" — so, Tašmajdan Park is perhaps the best place for training. Our ratings are 7 and 8.

questions.q: What is missing at Tašmajdan?
questions.e: In the video: "mi fali nešto čime mogu da se rade noge... Ja bih ovom parku dao ocenu 7, zato što radi samo pola tela" — I'm missing something to work the legs with... I'd give this park a 7, because it works only half the body.

questions.q: What rating did the "Olimp" park in Zvezdara get, and why is it better than Tašmajdan?
o: 8.5: well maintained, not crowded, with a monkey bar and a Sorensen hold
questions.e: In the video: "Rekao bih da je bolji od Taša, zato što nije razređen uopšte. Za ovaj park ide osam i po" — I'd say it's better than Taš, because it's not thinned out at all. This park gets an eight and a half.

questions.q: Why did the forest park in Zvezdara get 8, not 10?
o: Because of the low push-up bars
questions.e: In the video: "Bila bi čista desetka, samo da je bolje propadanje" — the bars are too low.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Idemo da vidimo *gradilište*.
questions.e: Gradilište — a construction site; graditi — to build.

questions.q: Ovde ide *šank*.
questions.e: Šank — a bar counter.

questions.q: Imamo tri *razboja* za propadanje.
questions.e: Razboj — parallel bars (gymnastics apparatus).

questions.q: Sprava za *zgibove*.
questions.e: Zgib — a pull-up on a bar.

questions.q: Ovde mogu da se rade *sklekovi*.
questions.e: Sklek — a push-up from the floor.

questions.q: Ima onaj *panj*.
questions.e: Panj — a stump.

questions.q: Nalazi se u debeloj *hladovini* Zvezdarske šume.
questions.e: Hladovina — shade, coolness.

questions.q: Malo je sve *odrano*, malo je prslo.
questions.e: Odrati — to scrape off, to peel off; odrano — scraped off, worn away.

questions.q: Sad sam se uputio na ___.
questions.e: Uputiti se na + accusative case; for inanimate nouns it coincides with the nominative: na Vračar.

questions.q: Verujemo da ćemo ___ 15. maja sve završiti.
questions.e: Do ("until, by") + genitive: do 15. maja — by 15 May.

questions.q: Svratili smo malo nešto da ___,
questions.e: After da the purpose is a single act, "have a bite": perfective pojedemo. Jedemo is imperfective (process or habit).

questions.q: Razboj je ___, a?
questions.e: The adjective agrees with the noun: razboj is masculine singular, so dobar.

questions.q: Dok izlazimo iz Tašmajdanskog ___, da sumiramo.
questions.e: Iz ("from") requires the genitive case: iz parka.

questions.q: Pa ovo što je Vuk rekao, znači sa ___ stvari se slažem.
questions.e: Slagati se sa ("to agree with") + instrumental: sa većinom stvari — with most things.

questions.q: Sviđa mi se jer se nalazi u debeloj ___.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u hladovini.

questions.q: Evo nas ___ Olimpu, dakle, zvezdarski hram sporta.
questions.e: For a venue like Olimp, "where?" takes na + locative: na Olimpu.
